content: APG TreeView pattern facts relevant to touch adaptation: required roles tree/treeitem/group; aria-expanded on parents only (end nodes must omit it); lazy-loaded trees must declare aria-level/aria-setsize/aria-posinset on every node; selection via aria-selected OR aria-checked, never both. The pattern page covers ONLY keyboard interaction and says nothing about touch or pointer input — touch sizing (44pt Apple HIG / 48dp Material) and no-hover-dependence come from platform HIGs, so a touch adaptation is purely presentational and must NOT change the ARIA contract. The existing SelectionTree.tsx already implements the full APG map (roving tabindex, tri-state aria-checked true/mixed/false, lazy children with setsize/posinset), so mobile adaptation = row height/density + hit targets + affordances, never a second tree component.
